# Pesher Habakkuk Column 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 1 | **Condition:** Upper portion heavily damaged; lower lines better preserved

---

**1:1** [...The or]acle that Habakkuk the-prophet received [in a vision...]

**1:2** [...] How-long, O LORD, shall-I-cry-out and-You-will-not-hear? [I-cry-out] to-You, "Violence!" and-You-will-not-save.

**1:3** Why do-You-show-me iniquity and-cause-me-to-look upon wrongdoing? Destruction and-violence are-before-me; there-is strife and-contention [arises...]

**1:4** [Its pesher concerns...] those-who were-unfaithful together-with the-Man-of-the-Lie, for they-did-not [heed the-words-of] the-Teacher-of-Righteousness from-the-mouth-of God.

**1:5** And-also [it-concerns] those-who-were-unfaithful-to the-new [covenant,] for they-did-not believe in-the-covenant-of God [and-profaned] His-holy name.

**1:6** And-likewise this word is-to-be-interpreted concerning the-unfaith[ful] at-the-end-of-days.

**1:7** They are the-ruthless-ones-of the-covenant who-will-not believe

**1:8** when-they-hear all that-is-to-come upon the-final generation

**1:9** from-the-mouth-of the-priest into-whose heart

**1:10** God put understanding to-interpret all the-words-of His-servants the-prophets,

**1:11** [through] whom God declared all that-is-to-come upon His-people and [His] congregation.

**1:12** "For-the-Torah grows-weak and-justice never goes-forth;

**1:13** for the-wicked surrounds the-righteous" (Hab 1:4).

**1:14** [Its pesher:] the-wicked is the-Wicked-Priest, and-the-righteous

**1:15** is the-Teacher-of-Righteousness [...]

**1:16** "Look among-the-nations and-observe,

**1:17** and-be-astonished, be-astounded [...]" (Hab 1:5)

---
*EMET notes: Column 1 covers Hab 1:1-5. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
